name: Click Trail
quote: Since May, her catalog's had five months of clicks... twelve... forty... sixty-eight... ninety-five... a hundred and forty-eight.
pitch: One member's clicks month by month as a trail that climbs: five points land in turn, a dotted line draws between them and the last point lights amber. Reusable for any one-member, many-months number.

catalogCheck.verdict: a single total, not one member's month by month

whyNew: nothing shows one member's number climbing over five months

stills.name: Switchback
stills.line: A dotted trail climbs; each month is a point.

stills.name: Ledger
stills.line: One bar per month, the last bar in sage.

stills.name: Summit
stills.line: The latest number, huge, with the trail below.

note: the lockup can't sit at the bottom (Instagram's caption and buttons cover it), so everything lives between y 230 and 1520, clear of the right-hand button rail.

renderCheck.note: first points inside the safe area
trail drawn, labels clear of the button rail
end point lit, nothing below y 1520, Roca loaded

name: Spread Map
quote: People clicked from fourteen different states.
pitch: A US map where clicks land as sage pins state by state, then the state count rolls in.

name: Load Shift
quote: She swapped her tent and her stove and her pack dropped almost two pounds.
pitch: Pack weight split into bars by category that shift as gear is swapped, the total ticking down.

catalogCheck.verdict: shows the total change, not which parts moved

whyNew: nothing shows parts of one whole shifting

name: Path Trace
quote: Saved reel: the climber's move traced frame by frame over the footage.
pitch: Trace a real move over footage: ghost frames, a dotted path, and a tick where it lands. For beta breakdowns in climbing reels.

catalogCheck.verdict: flies products in, can't follow a body

whyNew: nothing draws on top of moving footage

stills.name: Strobe trail
stills.line: Faded copies of the climber trail the move; dots mark the path to the hold.

stills.name: Hairline arc
stills.line: A thin line follows the hand from start to hold, with a tick per frame.

stills.name: Comet
stills.line: A bright head with a fading tail rides the move and pings on the hold.

name: Highlight Sweep
quote: Saved reel: a highlighter runs behind the caption as he says it.
pitch: A sage block runs behind words as they're said, on a card over footage.

catalogCheck.verdict: slams a whole line, can't follow speech

whyNew: nothing marks words in time with the voice

stills.name: Marker
stills.line: A sage band slides in behind each word as Luke says it.

stills.name: Underline run
stills.line: A line runs under the phrase and the words brighten in time.

stills.name: Lift out
stills.line: The phrase rises off its card while the card softens behind it.

name: Relay Line
quote: I record it, Claude edits it, the motion mod looks for graphics, and I approve them.
pitch: Steps of a process sit on one trail line (Record, Edit, Motion, Approve). A small amber marker walks the trail and each stop lights when Luke names it. Labels change per video, so it works for any how-we-work clip.

catalogCheck.verdict: fixed to GearBook's four member steps

whyNew: nothing shows a process with custom steps

name: Then vs Now Tally
quote: An edit that used to take me two weeks, I now get back in one morning.
pitch: Two bars, one labelled with the old time (2 weeks) and one with the new (1 morning), fill as the words are said, and the short one wins. Works for any before and after of time or effort.

catalogCheck.verdict: morphs numbers, can't show a duration

whyNew: nothing compares two lengths of time

name: Partner Unbox
quote: Can we get a box-opening graphic for the partner reels, using our own product photos?
pitch: The partner's box flaps open on the ridge line and three product photos rise out, each with a label tag.

catalogCheck.verdict: opens the episode, not the products

whyNew: nothing reveals products from a partner

name: Link Drop
quote: What if every time you recommended your favorite gear, you got paid?
pitch: A product card drops onto a phone screen, a tracked link draws from the card to a member's catalog and the catalog card gets a small sage tick. Reusable for any "how a recommendation becomes a link" moment.

catalogCheck.verdict: names the steps, never shows the link itself
shows the product, not where it goes

whyNew: nothing shows a recommendation turning into a link

name: Sport Switch
quote: Same catalog, from four thousand metres up to forty metres down.
pitch: A split gauge: an altimeter on top rolls up to 4,000 m while a depth gauge below rolls down to -40 m, both sitting on the same catalog card. For any reel that spans two sports.

catalogCheck.verdict: opens one sport at a time
two values, but not two directions at once

whyNew: nothing shows two sports on one catalog
